name: google-business
description: Google business tools for Claude: Google Analytics admin and data, Tag Manager, YouTube and YouTube Analytics, and Business Profile. Read-only unless you turn writes on.

allow_writes.title: Allow write tools
allow_writes.description: Expose tools that create or change business data. Delete and remove tools also need confirm=true in each call.

token_dir.title: Token directory (optional)
token_dir.description: Where OAuth tokens are stored. Leave empty for ~/.google-services-mcps.
